newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEDNESDAY FIRMER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on key currencies at the close of a fairly quiet Wednesday interbank session, dealers said.
"There wasn't much activity today...just a little two-way interbank trade. There was no sign of the central bank in the market," commented one dealer.
The local unit finished the day at 11.4000/4100 on the U.S. dollar, gaining half a cent from Tuesday's 11.4050/4150, and was at 18.8930/9250 against sterling from 18.9000/9300.
It was also firmer on South Africa's rand at 2.5150/5190 compared to 2.5200/5400 and at 6.5020/5140 from 6.5300/5500 versus the mark.
